paras: Omoadiphas texiguatensis is a species of snake in the family Dipsadidae.
It is found in the mountain range Cordillera Nombre de Dios of Yoro Department, Honduras.

McCranie & Castañeda, 2004 : A new species of snake of the genus Omoadiphas (Reptilia: Squamata: Colubridae) from the Cordillera Nombre de Dios in northern Honduras. Proceedings of the Biological Society of Washington, vol. 117, No. 3, p. 311-316 (archive).
